strategies.name: Sequential All-Reduce with Fused Local Ops
strategies.desc: Performs 8 consecutive all-reduce calls (one per stage), but fuses all local element-wise operations (scale, divide, clone, multiply) between consecutive all-reduces into single kernel dispatches using in-place operations where possible. Expected ~8 all-reduce dispatches + ~8 fused local-op dispatches = 16 total. Trades single-dispatch elegance for straightforward correctness and moderate dispatch count.

strategies.name: Precompute Scale Tensors, Vectorized Local Ops
strategies.desc: Precomputes all per-rank scale factors as full-size tensors (shape world*256) once, then performs 8 all-reduces with vectorized multiply/divide operations that avoid per-shard loops by broadcasting scale tensors. Expected ~8 all-reduce dispatches + ~2 precompute dispatches + ~8 vectorized scale dispatches = 18 total. Trades slightly more dispatches for eliminating inner loops and enabling better compiler vectorization.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter / All-Gather Decomposition per Stage
strategies.desc: Replaces each all-reduce with a reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, allowing local computation to happen on smaller per-rank shards (size 256) between the two phases, then all-gather broadcasts the scaled result. Expected ~8 stages × 2 collectives = 16 collective dispatches + ~8 local-op dispatches = 24 total. Trades more collectives for smaller intermediate working sets and potential memory bandwidth savings.

strategies.name: Pipelined Two-Phase with Overlap
strategies.desc: Groups the 8 stages into two phases of 4 stages each; pipeline the first 4 all-reduces by issuing them asynchronously with overlapping local computation, then barrier and repeat for second phase. Expected ~8 all-reduce dispatches + ~8 async local-op dispatches = 16 total, but with potential latency hiding. Trades complexity and synchronization overhead for communication-computation overlap.

strategies.name: Mega-Fused Single All-Reduce with Staged Metadata
strategies.desc:
Concatenates all 8 stage computations into a single massive buffer (8× world*256), performs one giant all-reduce on the concatenated data, then post-processes locally to extract and combine stage results using tensor views and reshapes. Expected ~1 all-reduce dispatch + ~10 local reshape/view/combine dispatches = 11 total. Trades memory footprint (8× larger) and complex post-processing for minimal collective count.
